user.title: Add a Tapo camera
user.description:
Enter the camera's IP address on your home network and the password of the TP-Link account you log in to the Tapo app with.

The camera is reached directly on your home network with this password; TP-Link's servers are not contacted.

data_description.host: The camera's IP address on your home network, e.g. 192.168.1.50. The Tapo app shows it under camera → Settings → Device info. A fixed IP address (DHCP reservation) is recommended.
data_description.cloud_password: The password you log in to the Tapo app with. The camera accepts it locally for the "admin" user; Tapo Control logs in the same way with a cloud password.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter the password again
reauth_confirm.description: The camera rejected the password several times in a row. If you changed your TP-Link account password, enter the new one.

data_description.cloud_password: The password you log in to the Tapo app with. The camera accepts it locally for the "admin" user; Tapo Control logs in the same way with a cloud password.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the camera
reconfigure.description: Change the camera's IP address or TP-Link account password. If a different camera answers at the new IP address, nothing is saved.

data_description.host: The camera's IP address on your home network, e.g. 192.168.1.50. The Tapo app shows it under camera → Settings → Device info. A fixed IP address (DHCP reservation) is recommended.
data_description.cloud_password: The password you log in to the Tapo app with. The camera accepts it locally for the "admin" user; Tapo Control logs in the same way with a cloud password.

error.invalid_auth: The password was not accepted. Enter the password of the TP-Link account you log in to the Tapo app with.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the camera. Check the IP address and that the camera is on and connected.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.wrong_camera: A different camera answers at this IP address.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the alarm and notification settings are read.
